text:
Sara: @noah quick one — CloudScale (potential reseller) is asking for a 32% reseller margin + a one-off marketing rebate to enable a GovBank POC. Can partnerships advise on approvability?

Noah: What's the expected committed revenue or ARR if this converts? Any special security/data residency asks?

Sara: POC is 6mo but they will only do it if margin economics work. Conversion plan: if successful they commit to 12 months, estimated $72k/mo run-rate (they'd resell Dedicated nodes). Rough rate card we quoted: 
```
Dedicated - A40: $9,000/mo
Dedicated - P4: $12,000/mo
```
They want to resell at list and take 32% margin. Also asking for $12k marketing credit to support joint outreach during the POC.

Maria: 32% is well above our standard channel margin (20%). Need conversion probability and a one-year P&L to sign off. Also need GL code for the marketing rebate.

Kevin: From deal-desk POV we can consider a structured exception: propose 28% margin + $8k marketing credit as counter. Anything >28% needs VP RevOps approval and a signed commit. Please file an exception ticket with LOI + SOW.

Sara: CloudScale says anything <30% breaks their economics — they can do a 12mo minimum if we hit 32. Their value: strong Gov vertical coverage, past relationships at GovBank.

Ashley: Legal note — GovBank requires private deployment language and SOC2 attestations in contract. We can't finalize reseller terms or rebate until we have a signed reseller/MSP addendum that covers liability and lead handling.

deal-desk-bot: New discount-exception request created: ID DD-2026-0034. Request details: 32% reseller margin + $12,000 marketing credit for CloudScale POC. Attachments: cloudscale_LOI.pdf, draft_sow.pdf. Pending approvals: Finance, Legal, Partnerships, VP RevOps.

Maria: I'll run a break-even and post the expected net cost first year. Condition for Finance approval: signed 12mo minimum commit and evidence of pipeline conversion (names/contacts).

Noah: Partnerships rule: up to 28% can be approved as a launch promo for strategic partners. Above that needs VP sign-off. @Kevin please escalate to VP RevOps if the AE insists on 32.

Kevin: Escalating DD-2026-0034 to VP RevOps now, updated ticket with CloudScale LOI.

Lena: I can approve 32% only if ALL of the following are true: (a) minimum 12mo committed revenue >= $800k (b) signed reseller addendum in our standard form (c) lead routing + co-sell credit established in CRM and (d) Finance confirms rebate budget. If those land, I'm OK to greenlight. @Sara DM me the CloudScale revenue model and convert forecast.

Sara: Ack — will DM and upload conversion forecast + LOI to the ticket.

Noah: Marking for follow-up. If VP signs, Legal to finalize addendum and Finance to allocate marketing GL.

Sara: thanks all — will keep thread updated. :thumbsup:
